description: What the Georgia DCH OIG exclusions data covers and how current it is: total exclusions currently on the list, how many carry an NPI, how many distinct provider types appear, and the oldest/newest sanction effective date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line note that this is a current-snapshot list (DCH removes reinstated providers rather than flagging them). Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have a sanction effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 1,300+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Georgia DCH OIG exclusions had a 2025 effective date". The response names the date field counted (sanction_date / DCH's SANCDATE, the only date field this list publishes). Sourced from the Georgia DCH OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities, keyless.

end_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with start_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

start_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

year.description: Count records whose date field falls in this calendar year (e.g. 2025), counted over the WHOLE list, not a page. Ignored if start_date/end_date are given.
